paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. It was lovely to hear from you. You asked me about a student employment workshop, so I am happy to share some information. I hope it helps you decide what to do.

paragraphs.text: First of all, it will take place at the local library on Saturday at two in the afternoon. We will plan a study-friendly work schedule and practise customer conversations.
